name: SQL Injection (DVWA)
short_description: Learn SQL injection basics and extract database contents.
description: SQL injection is one of the most common web vulnerabilities. By injecting SQL commands into input fields, attackers can bypass authentication, extract data, or even take over the server. DVWA provides a safe environment to practice these techniques.

steps.title: Access DVWA in browser
steps.explanation: First, verify DVWA is running. Then open http://localhost:8080 in your browser.

steps.title: Login to DVWA
steps.explanation: Open http://localhost:8080 in your browser. Login with admin / password

steps.title: Set security to Low
steps.explanation: Click 'DVWA Security' in the left menu. Set Security Level to 'Low' and click Submit. This removes protections so you can learn the basics.

steps.title: Go to SQL Injection page
steps.explanation: Click 'SQL Injection' in the left menu. You'll see a User ID input field.
steps.expected: A form asking for User ID

steps.title: Test for SQL injection
steps.explanation: Enter this in the User ID field and submit. The single quote breaks the SQL query.
steps.expected: You see a SQL error message - this confirms SQLi vulnerability!

steps.title: Extract all users
steps.explanation: This makes the WHERE clause always true, returning all users.
steps.expected: You see multiple users listed (admin, gordonb, etc.)

steps.title: Use UNION to extract data
steps.command: ' UNION SELECT user, password FROM users-- -
steps.explanation: UNION combines results from another query. We're extracting usernames and password hashes.
steps.expected: You see usernames and MD5 password hashes

steps.title: Use SQLMap for automation
steps.explanation: SQLMap automates SQL injection. Replace YOUR_SESSION_ID with your actual session cookie from the browser (F12 > Application > Cookies).
steps.expected: SQLMap finds the vulnerability and lists databases

steps.title: Dump the users table
steps.explanation: This extracts all data from the users table, including password hashes.
steps.expected: Full user table with cracked passwords

success_criteria: You can extract usernames and password hashes using manual SQLi or SQLMap. Bonus: crack the hashes!
next_steps: Use John to crack the MD5 hashes
